title: Weekly Study Hours (EnumMap)
hints: Loop over Day.values() once to put 0 for every day, so all seven days are printed.
To add hours: map.put(day, map.get(day) + hours).
Iterating over an EnumMap goes Monday → Sunday. Only replace the busiest day when a total is strictly greater.

mustContain.message: Store the hours in an EnumMap<Day, Integer>.
